1.title: Fixing the PR Bottleneck — Matt Pocock, AIHero
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Agent experience (AX) deserves the same rigor as developer experience (DX) — the PR review bottleneck isn't about writing speed, it's about what happens around the PR.

2.title: Where AI products go next: voice, agents, and self-driving software | Tara Sesha and Nan Yu (OpenAI)
2.author: Lenny's Podcast
2.hook: OpenAI PMs discuss shipping imperfect AI features, designing understandable agents, and agent-tool integration decisions — live recording from Sept 2026.

3.title: Why Claude can’t be your PM (yet) | Anthropic CPO Panel
3.author: Lenny's Podcast
3.hook: Anthropic CPO and Instagram co-founder discuss how PM fundamentals (user understanding, decision-making, adaptation) remain essential when AI changes what teams can ship every few months, plus specifics on agent-native software design and parallel experimentation.

4.title: Why I took the summer off from AI (and what I learned) | Karri Saarinen (Linear)
4.author: Lenny's Podcast
4.hook: Linear's CEO shares how his team uses AI tooling (customer briefings, quality reviews) while deliberately protecting space for judgment-building through customer conversations and shared critique.

1.author: Peter Yang
1.hook: Peter Yang tests OpenAI's Dots agent across real tasks (sponsorship discovery, app launch, landing page, YouTube comment analysis) and compares it to Grok Bot and Muse.
